name: Giddy Up: using an action on the mount gets you off, then the action goes off (Machinist, on foot to start, Reassemble ready, mount SDS Fenrir)

steps.msg: start on foot, out of combat
dismount on action (with the action afterwards) should be on and the hook in place
Giddy Up should press Dismount instead of the action
you should be off the mount
Reassemble should go off once you're on your feet
Dismount and Reassemble each used once
